change: Explicitly disabled Qwen3 thinking for all six tasks.
other_generation_parameters: Model, prompts, temperatures, output limits, timeouts, retry budget and backoff were preserved. Worker/chunk concurrency is documented by stage below.
queue_policy: Separate fresh queue and output. Prior provider-native responses are not mixed into this experiment. Do not automatically retry uncertain requests or deferred cases.

throttled_resume.reason: Two-task concurrency still produced repeated TPM 429 responses; resumed sequentially in line with README shared-account guidance.; ordered delayed X retry queues later to let their backoff windows expire while earlier tasks progress.

concurrency.reason: Initial 10-worker burst produced provider 429 code 50602 (TPM limit reached); all affected DEFERRED cases were audited before requeue.

readme_rule: README_交接.md requires changed model/parameters to be recorded separately; this experiment follows that instruction.

stages.action: Gracefully stopped new dispatches after TPM-limit 429s; preserved active response artifacts; reduced total concurrency to two one-worker tasks and reopened only cases whose three recorded attempts were all explicit 429/50602 TPM rejections.

Two-worker pass ended after repeated 429/50602 TPM errors. Requeued 24 more cases only where every attempt was an explicit TPM rejection and no answer file existed; left 1 G1 connection-error case deferred. Next pass uses one global worker.
